robot_native: アイレック (AI-driven Robot for Embrace and Care)
company: Waseda University Sugano Lab / JST Moonshot Goal 3
company_native: 早稲田大学 菅野研究室
target_applications: nursing/elder care (repositioning, transfer, dressing), housework, medical support (ultrasound, medication, vitals); facilities ~2030

base_type.value: wheeled round mobile base with articulated single-column lower body (NOT bipedal in current prototypes)

payload_total_kg.source: (lifts/repositions human upper body in demos, mannequin 8kg + supports patient torso)

torso_lift.value: articulated column lower body with knee-like bend for bed-height and floor tasks

actuators.value: electric torque-controlled joints ('dry'); future 'wet' phase: back-drivable hydraulics, self-healing materials; hardware by Tokyo Robotics

software_stack.value: research AI: PV-RNN predictive processing, deep predictive learning, vision+proprioception integration; autonomy Levels 1-3 roadmap (2025 semi-autonomous, 2030 collaborative care)

safety_compliance.value: research; compliance via torque sensing; no certification

availability.value: not available; care/medical facilities ~2030; 10 final prototypes planned for social demonstration

deployment_evidence.value: care-facility trials since 2024; demos: patient rolling, supine-to-sit transfer, sock dressing, scrambled eggs, laundry, autonomous ultrasound, medication 5R workflow

notes: BASE-TYPE CONFLICT RESOLVED: current Dry-AIREC prototypes are wheeled (column + round base), not bipedal; bipedal descriptions refer to long-term 2050 concept. Hardware built by Tokyo Robotics (Yaskawa subsidiary).
